note: Real run on 2026-10-05 (ad data) and 2026-10-06 (page reads) through the InsightfulPipe MCP on a client Google Ads account, anonymised: account, campaign, ad group, firm, attorney, state and city names replaced, the site domain replaced with example-firm.com, ad and campaign ids replaced, money rounded to the nearest $10. Generated by script from the raw query results. Every landing page read failed on this run: the screenshot, crawler and PageSpeed services returned fetch errors for every URL, test pages included, for several hours. The firm's site also puts a human-verification check in front of automated visitors (status-code-checker returned HTTP 403 for these pages on 2026-10-02). So the sample shows the skill's blocked-page path: match scores stay unscored and the report asks for screenshots instead of guessing.
request: Hey Claude, I just added the "ad-landing-page-match-scorer" skill. Check every active ad in my Google Ads account against the page it sends people to, and tell me which routes lose the most.

scope.pages_to_read: top 10 by spend (7 unique pages exist)

keyword_view with Quality Score components: 122 keyword rows
campaign_asset: 118 sitelinks, callouts and structured snippets
